title: Cortex TrainingDataCandidate (DRAFT v0)
description: A normalized example for a forge lane. Represents a curated example ready for inclusion in a training dataset for a specific forge lane. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer.

lane.description: The forge lane this example is intended for.

source_url.description: URL to the source of this example (repo, issue, PR, etc.).

source_commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA when this example was harvested.

grounded.description: Whether this example is grounded in verified/correct information.

quality_score.description: Quality score assigned by the harvester (0-100).

created_at.description: When this candidate was created (ISO-8601 UTC).
